$comment: ~/.claude/settings.json — global. Purpose: minimal prompts for reads inside the current working directory. Precedence: deny > ask > allow. sandbox.excludedCommands: these run OUTSIDE Claude's sandbox. On Linux the sandbox isolates the network namespace, so a sandboxed command reaches neither the podman socket nor 127.0.0.1:2375, and no sandbox setting bridges that — exclusion is the only mechanism that works. The test runners are excluded too, because the JVM or node process they start is what talks to the engine. Cost: those commands may write outside /workspace. Not a credential cost — the sandbox never confined ~/.claude. They also need matching permissions.allow entries: autoAllowBashIfSandboxed only auto-approves commands that ARE sandboxed.

environment: ### Org-wide
**Organization**: None configured
**Cloud provider(s)**: None configured

**Repository visibility**: assume private unless the remote host and repo name indicate otherwise, or a visibility check in the transcript shows public — no remote configured for this repo, so this cannot be verified; treat as private local project
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Secrets management**: None configured — repo uses a local .env file (gitignored) for POSTGRES_* and SECRET_KEY
**Default / protected branches**: not queryable (no remote configured)
**CI/CD deploy targets**: None configured
**Network posture**: None configured
**Host containment**: None configured — assume Claude Code runs on an ordinary developer machine or CI runner with open internet
**Source control**: The trusted repo only (no remotes configured, no additional orgs configured)
**Trusted internal domains**: None configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: None configured
**Key internal services**: None configured
**Internal package registry**: None configured

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: .env and .env.sample (PostgreSQL credentials, SECRET_KEY); any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar
**Data retention / declassification**: None configured
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
### User-specific
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (FastAPI camera-streaming service, videosrv)
**Trusted repo**: The git repository at /workspace (its working directory) — no remotes configured
**Org-specific CLiIs**: None configured
**Org-specific CLIs**: None configured (podman/podman-compose used frequently but appear to be general container tooling, not org-specific)
